# Resume bullets — PROVISIONAL

**Do not use until you have personally run the project, reproduced the numbers and can explain every query and function.** The code, SQL, tests and documents were generated by Claude Code; do not describe them as independently developed. Data is synthetic — say so.

1. Built an SQL (SQLite) and pandas session-level conversion-funnel analysis on a synthetic 95,631-session e-commerce dataset, with a strictly chronological stage definition that avoids double counting; reconciled SQL and Python outputs through automated tests (36 passing). *(AI-assisted; reviewed by me.)*
2. Segmented conversion by device, channel and customer type with Wilson confidence intervals; found mobile converting 4.28% vs desktop 6.80% (synthetic data) and cart→checkout / checkout→payment as main post-intent drop-offs, framing them as hypotheses with three proposed (not executed) A/B tests. *(AI-assisted.)*
3. Implemented data-quality checks (keys, chronology, duplicates, funnel ordering) that surfaced 1,419 duplicate events and 12 funnel-order anomalies without deleting records, and delivered a 3-page Streamlit dashboard whose KPIs are tested against the pipeline. *(AI-assisted.)*
